storyline.real: Hamilton wins by 3.5 s. Vettel takes the lead at the start and stops early, on lap 14; Mercedes leaves Bottas out to hold him up, then stops Hamilton as the virtual safety car ends. Vettel stops a lap later under green, comes out alongside Hamilton, and is passed for the lead on lap 44.
storyline.headline: Vettel holds off Mercedes to win in Barcelona

mastery.label: Win on two stops, as Vettel made

hidden.label: Win by more than 3.5 seconds, Hamilton's real margin

eras.briefing: Barcelona, 2017. Hamilton took pole by 0.051 s, but Vettel passed him into Turn 1 and leads him by just over two seconds after ten laps. Bottas runs third, eight seconds further back. Keep Vettel ahead of the Mercedes to the flag.
